definitions.explanation: The two eyes considered together. Used when referring to actions or conditions involving both eyes simultaneously.

examples.japanese: {両目|りょうめ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{閉|と}じた→閉じる：02303_tojiru⟧。
{両目|りょうめ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧あふれた。
{手術後|しゅじゅつご}、{両目|りょうめ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{視力|しりょく}→視力：05033_shiryoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{回復|かいふく}した→回復する：21330_kaifukusuru⟧。
examples.english: After surgery, the vision in both eyes recovered.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{両|りょう}→両：11182_ryou⟧ (both) and ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧ (eye). Straightforward in meaning but useful for distinguishing actions or conditions affecting both eyes versus just one. The prefix ⟦{両|りょう}→両：11182_ryou⟧ is productive and appears in many similar compounds.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {両目|りょうめ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}ける→開ける：00563_akeru⟧: to open both eyes
- {両目|りょうめ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{閉|と}じる→閉じる：02303_tojiru⟧: to close both eyes
- {両目|りょうめ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to look with both eyes

RELATED TERMS WITH {両|りょう}:
- ⟦{両手|りょうて}→両手：09518_ryoute⟧: both hands
- ⟦{両足|りょうあし}→両足：28926_ryouashi⟧: both legs/feet
- ⟦{両耳|りょうみみ}→両耳：25207_ryoumimi⟧: both ears
- ⟦{片目|かため}→片目：20229_katame⟧: one eye — the counterpart using ⟦{片|かた}→片：26670_kata⟧ (one of a pair)
